citations.desc: Attending veterinarian and adequate veterinary care (dealers and exhibitors).
citations.narrative:
The facility has an attending veterinarian, but there is no written program of veterinary care and the attending veterinarian
has not conducted any visits to the premises since taking over. Not having a program of veterinary care and not having
the attending veterinarian conduct regularly scheduled visits doesn't ensure the health or well-being of the animals as well
as to helping identify any animal husbandry issues that may affect the animals. The licensee must have a written program
of veterinary care from the attending veterinarian and the licensee must make arrangements to have the attending
veterinarian conduct regularly scheduled visits to the premises.
This inspection and exit interview were conducted with the facility representative.
End of report.
